This 👇🏻


Tom Cotton (@SenTomCotton)

Marijuana today is much more potent than just ten or twenty years ago, leading to increased psychosis, anti-social behavior, and fatal car crashes. Arkansans don’t want more dangerous drugs obtained more easily. A change to marijuana’s drug classification is a step in the wrong direction.
Community note: Tom is lying - Opinion polls consistently show that Arkansans favor legalizing marijuana:

One thing I’m proud of as I have aged and grown in my faith is a capacity to forgive as Christ teaches us.

I have also learned that hating someone daily is like drinking poison and only hurts me. Things in life really play out as they should and I choose to live in light.

"I didn't take any actions, but I seriously considered it."

If a major political win can't protect someone from going to a very dark place, there is a national mental health crisis we can't ignore.
